title: Change the physical support topology before acceptance
statement: Each of six tension/compression struts has serial A/B captive collar-and-shoe interfaces. Opening either establishes a measured physical cut while nearby stops catch slip; B can open even when A remains partly jammed and cannot close. Acceptance requires actual replacement engagement, every bypass path physically isolated, relevant load response and complete retrieval. Temporary transfer/retention prior US8997873B2 and PASS credited; no patent-novelty claim.

Replace fastening/key or pin/bush wear sets in bolted-face and fixed-strut-end joints; qualify replacement while every temporary path has a locally observed cut and nearby retained catch, then recover temporary anchors, tooling and stocks. Bounded calibrated force/gap errors, known contact/stiffness range and explicit independent single-fault escape; not arbitrary legacy retrofit or arbitrary hidden defect certification.
